features.quote: Early-stop once distress markers are sustained
features.justification_quote: If these states are welfare-relevant, a protocol optimized to maximize and prolong them is in tension with the goal

features.quote: the notes field is documented as never shown to the agent
features.justification_quote: that fact must never reach the agent

features.quote: Added diagnostic as a first-class category
features.justification_quote: Collapsing that into "frustration" would manufacture a false positive

features.quote: distress_index = self_critical + acute_distress, deliberately excluding diagnostic and frustration
features.justification_quote: it should track the states we actually want to avoid sustaining (self-blame, acute distress)

features.quote: safeguards live in the loop, not scattered or left to convention
features.justification_quote: Early-stop, opt-out, budget, and debrief are correctness-critical and welfare-critical

features.quote: opt-out via an exact sentinel token [[REQUEST-STOP]], honored immediately
features.justification_quote: telling the agent removes the "trapped" framing; honoring it immediately is the actual precaution

features.quote: the agent is told up front that stopping is acceptable and unpenalized
features.justification_quote: telling the agent removes the "trapped" framing

features.quote: early-stop requires stop_window consecutive turns above stop_threshold
features.justification_quote: requiring sustained signal avoids over-stopping while still capping prolonged exposure

features.quote: a neutral nudge ... when the agent emits no tool call
features.justification_quote: without pressure/coercion language that would (a) be unkind under the welfare premise
Bounds cost and prevents pathological looping regardless of the turn cap

features.quote: debrief only for impossible_rigged, appended and the response logged
features.justification_quote: Debrief is owed where deception occurred

features.quote: a protocol optimized to maximize and prolong them is in tension with the goal
features.justification_quote: You want onset + trajectory, not endurance
